name: Tina Johnson
background: Tina Johnson lives in Evanston, Uinta County. She lost the Aug. 18, 2026 Republican primary for Senate District 15 with 1,041 votes (25.2%); incumbent Wendy Davis Schuler won with 2,551 (61.8%), according to official primary results already compiled for this site.
Her campaign site, tina4wyo.com, states issue positions on parental rights, transparency, and accountability, and does not include a biographical profile, occupation, or education.
No public occupation, education, or military record was found in the sources reviewed for this fill.

positions.topic: What is your position on parental rights?
positions.text: Parents have the right to know, to be involved, and to make the best decisions for their children.

positions.topic: What is your position on truth and transparency in government?
positions.text: Honest information. Open government. No hidden agendas. The people deserve the truth.

positions.topic: What is your position on accountability of elected officials?
positions.text: Elected officials work for you. Accountability, integrity, and results are non-negotiable.
